# Agent CLI

<!-- Generated by `bin/agent-cli docs --write` from the registry in bin/agent-cli.mjs; edit the registry, not this page. -->

`bin/agent-cli` answers the lookups agents repeat on this repository: the state of the branch, its pull request and CI, issues and epics, the modules, the documentation, the decisions, and a terse `./gradlew` run. It needs Node 22 or later and, for the GitHub commands, an authenticated `gh`. `AGENTS.md` sends agents to it first.

Every command prints terse lines for an agent, or JSON with `--json`. Exit codes: 0 done, 1 the answer is a failure (a red check, a lint hit), 2 wrong usage, 3 stale, 4 unavailable (no `gh`, no pull request).

## Keeping it current

- **Read at run time.** No answer is stored: each command reads the file or calls the tool that owns the fact.
- **Stale fails loudly.** A source that no longer parses gives exit 3 and `stale: <source>: <what>`, never an empty or partial answer.
- **Checked with the build.** `./gradlew check` runs `agentCliTest`: the unit tests, then `selftest`, which runs every offline command against the repository and checks that this page matches the registry. A change that moves a file the CLI reads fails in its own pull request.
- **Usage feeds back.** A `PostToolUse` hook in `.claude/settings.json` runs `agent-cli hook`: when an agent types a raw command a subcommand covers, the hook tells it so. `agent-cli stats` reads the Claude Code transcripts of this checkout and lists, per command, the raw calls still made and the calls through the CLI, plus the repeated lookups no command covers yet: add those, delete the commands nobody calls.

To add a command, add an entry to `REGISTRY` in `bin/agent-cli.mjs` (with its `sources` and `match`), a test in `bin/agent-cli.test.mjs`, then run `bin/agent-cli docs --write`.

## Commands

| Command | What it answers |
| --- | --- |
| [`status`](#status) | branch, upstream, ahead and behind the base branch, dirty files, commits and diff size since the base |
| [`pr`](#pr) | pull request state, mergeability, review and its checks, failing ones by name |
| [`prs`](#prs) | open pull requests, one line each: branches, mergeability, checks as pass/fail/pending |
| [`ci`](#ci) | failed CI runs of the pull request, a run or the branch: failed jobs, steps and the log lines that say why |
| [`wait`](#wait) | blocks until the pull request checks settle, or until it is merged; exit 1 if a check fails |
| [`issue`](#issue) | an issue: state, labels, milestone, parent and sub-issues, body |
| [`issues`](#issues) | open issues, one line each, with labels and milestone |
| [`epic`](#epic) | an epic's sub-issues with their state and open pull requests, how many are done and the next one |
| [`labels`](#labels) | the repository labels and what each is for |
| [`repo`](#repo) | repository settings: default branch, merge methods, rulesets and their required checks, Pages, variable and secret names |
| [`modules`](#modules) | Gradle projects with their folder and plugins, and the product folders that are not Gradle projects |
| [`doc`](#doc) | which page to read: the "Before you" table of AGENTS.md, the best pages for a topic, or every page with its title |
| [`adr`](#adr) | the decision records with status, the next free number, or those matching a topic |
| [`workflows`](#workflows) | GitHub Actions workflows with their name, triggers and jobs |
| [`lint`](#lint) | em dashes in tracked text files, which the writing rules forbid; exit 1 on a hit |
| [`check`](#check) | runs Gradle tasks with the full log in build/agent-cli/check.log and prints the result, failed tasks and first errors |
| [`stats`](#stats) | from the Claude Code transcripts of this checkout: raw calls each command would have answered, calls through the CLI, and repeated lookups no command covers |
| [`hook`](#hook) | Claude Code PostToolUse hook: reads the tool call on stdin and, when a command covers it, says which |
| [`docs`](#docs) | the reference page of this CLI, generated from its registry |
| [`selftest`](#selftest) | checks the CLI against the repository: declared sources exist, offline commands answer, the page is current, the hook is wired |

### status

Branch, upstream, ahead and behind the base branch, dirty files, commits and diff size since the base.

```text
bin/agent-cli status [--json]
```

Replaces: `git status`, `git log base..HEAD`, `git diff --stat base...HEAD`, `git branch`, `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`.

### pr

Pull request state, mergeability, review and its checks, failing ones by name.

```text
bin/agent-cli pr [<number>] [--json]
```

Replaces: `gh pr view`, `gh pr checks`, `gh pr status`.

### prs

Open pull requests, one line each: branches, mergeability, checks as pass/fail/pending.

```text
bin/agent-cli prs [--all] [--limit 30] [--json]
  --all            closed and merged ones too
  --limit <n>      at most (30)
  --json           machine-readable output
```

Replaces: `gh pr list --state open`.

### ci

Failed CI runs of the pull request, a run or the branch: failed jobs, steps and the log lines that say why.

```text
bin/agent-cli ci [<pr> | <run-id>] [--lines <n>] [--json]
  --lines <n>      error lines kept per run (40)
  --json           machine-readable output
```

Replaces: `gh run list`, `gh run view --log-failed | grep error`.

### wait

Blocks until the pull request checks settle, or until it is merged; exit 1 if a check fails.

```text
bin/agent-cli wait [<pr>] [--merged] [--timeout 30m] [--interval 20s] [--json]
  --merged         wait for the pull request to be merged or closed
  --timeout <d>    give up after (30m)
  --interval <d>   poll every (20s)
  --json           machine-readable output
```

Replaces: `until gh pr view ... = MERGED; do sleep; done`, `gh run watch`, `gh pr checks --watch`.

### issue

An issue: state, labels, milestone, parent and sub-issues, body.

```text
bin/agent-cli issue <number> [--no-body] [--json]
  --no-body        leave the body out
  --json           machine-readable output
```

Replaces: `gh issue view <n> --json title,body,labels`.

### issues

Open issues, one line each, with labels and milestone.

```text
bin/agent-cli issues [--all] [--label <name>] [--limit 30] [--json]
  --all            closed ones too
  --label <name>   only this label
  --limit <n>      at most (30)
  --json           machine-readable output
```

Replaces: `gh issue list`.

### epic

An epic's sub-issues with their state and open pull requests, how many are done and the next one.

```text
bin/agent-cli epic <number> [--json]
```

Replaces: `gh api repos/.../issues/<n>/sub_issues`.

### labels

The repository labels and what each is for.

```text
bin/agent-cli labels [--json]
```

Replaces: `gh label list`.

### repo

Repository settings: default branch, merge methods, rulesets and their required checks, Pages, variable and secret names.

```text
bin/agent-cli repo [--json]
```

Replaces: `gh repo view --json ...`, `gh api repos/.../rulesets`, `gh variable list`, `gh secret list`.

### modules

Gradle projects with their folder and plugins, and the product folders that are not Gradle projects.

```text
bin/agent-cli modules [--json]
```

Reads: `settings.gradle.kts`.

Replaces: `cat settings.gradle.kts`, `find . -name build.gradle.kts`, `ls apps`.

### doc

Which page to read: the "Before you" table of AGENTS.md, the best pages for a topic, or every page with its title.

```text
bin/agent-cli doc [<topic words>] [--all] [--limit 5] [--json]
  --all            every page under docs/ with its title and length
  --limit <n>      matches shown for a topic (5)
  --json           machine-readable output
```

Reads: `AGENTS.md`, `docs`.

Replaces: `grep -n '' README.md AGENTS.md mkdocs.yml`, `wc -l docs/**/*.md`, `ls docs`.

### adr

The decision records with status, the next free number, or those matching a topic.

```text
bin/agent-cli adr [<topic words>] [--json]
```

Reads: `docs/architecture/decisions`, `docs/architecture/decisions.md`.

Replaces: `ls docs/architecture/decisions | tail`, `head docs/architecture/decisions/<n>-*.md`.

### workflows

GitHub Actions workflows with their name, triggers and jobs.

```text
bin/agent-cli workflows [--json]
```

Reads: `.github/workflows`.

Replaces: `ls .github/workflows`.

### lint

Em dashes in tracked text files, which the writing rules forbid; exit 1 on a hit.

```text
bin/agent-cli lint [--json]
```

Replaces: `grep -rn $'\u2014' README.md AGENTS.md docs`.

### check

Runs Gradle tasks with the full log in build/agent-cli/check.log and prints the result, failed tasks and first errors.

```text
bin/agent-cli check [docs | <module> | <task>...] [-- <gradle args>] [--json]
  docs             docsLint and docsBuild
  <module>         a module's short name, e.g. api or shared: its check task
  <task>           any Gradle task, passed as is
  --json           machine-readable output
```

Reads: `gradlew`, `settings.gradle.kts`.

Replaces: `./gradlew check > log; tail log`, `./gradlew docsLint docsBuild 2>&1 | grep error`.

### stats

From the Claude Code transcripts of this checkout: raw calls each command would have answered, calls through the CLI, and repeated lookups no command covers.

```text
bin/agent-cli stats [--since <ISO date>] [--min 3] [--limit 15] [--dir <transcript folder>]... [--json]
  --since <date>   only calls after this ISO date
  --min <n>        sessions a lookup must recur in to be a candidate (3)
  --dir <path>     another transcript folder, repeatable
  --json           machine-readable output
```

### hook

Claude Code PostToolUse hook: reads the tool call on stdin and, when a command covers it, says which.

```text
bin/agent-cli hook < tool-call.json
```

Reads: `.claude/settings.json`.

### docs

The reference page of this CLI, generated from its registry.

```text
bin/agent-cli docs [--write | --check] [--json]
  --write          writes docs/contributor/reference/agent-cli.md
  --check          exit 1 when the page differs from the registry
  --json           machine-readable output
```

Reads: `docs/contributor/reference/agent-cli.md`.

### selftest

Checks the CLI against the repository: declared sources exist, offline commands answer, the page is current, the hook is wired.

```text
bin/agent-cli selftest [--json]
```
